exact_source_mapping.decision: DO_NOT_PUT_CONTAINER_RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING_HERE. Container/process/cgroup observations have different causal scope and identity from host facts.

exact_source_mapping.observed: ChildTelemetrySample binds caller-supplied cpu_time_ns and peak_rss_bytes as non-negative integers to one exact ChildReconcileEvidence. The constructor defaults both resource fields to 0 and the schema has no typed UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/SUPERSET resource state or observer-scope identity.
exact_source_mapping.decision: DO_NOT_USE_ZERO_AS_UNKNOWN_AND_DO_NOT_STRETCH_CHILD_SCOPE_TO_CONTAINER_SCOPE. Existing provenance_refs are opaque and do not by themselves encode observer coverage semantics.

exact_source_mapping.decision: REUSE_THIS_CANDIDATE; NO SECOND RESOURCE-WITNESS SCHEMA OR AUTHORITY.

architecture_decision.core_law: resource value and resource observation scope/coverage are separate facts; a numeric value is promotion-bearing only when an exact observer binding establishes what population/subtree it measures
witness_ladder: DEDICATED_SUBTREE + stable membership + readable cgroup-v2 counter => EXACT_CANDIDATE container/workload resource evidence
SHARED_PARENT_SUPERSET => SUPERSET evidence only; never exact container usage/isolation
identified process set without exact container membership => PROCESS_SCOPED_DEGRADED only
architecture_decision.preferred_integration_boundary: target-runtime/read-only execution evidence path that can bind container/execution identity, host payload PID/process incarnation, host cgroup path, membership snapshot/digest, exact metric file/value, scope_class, coverage_status, observed_at and provenance_ref; keep this observation non-authoritative and non-completing

counterhypothesis_resolution.counterhypothesis: Existing WP1201 OBSERVED/UNKNOWN facts plus WP605 provenance_refs are sufficient; no typed witness object is needed.
why: WP1201 is intentionally host-fact scoped and its fixed probe allow-list contains no container/workload identity binding.
WP605 resource fields are integers and cannot natively distinguish measured zero from unavailable/unknown/superset evidence.
WP605 provenance_refs are opaque references, while the promotion discriminator requires explicit observer scope/coverage semantics at the consumer boundary.
Reusing the already-created R6-SEED-006 CgroupWitness candidate avoids schema proliferation while closing this expressivity gap.

falsifiers_and_negative_results: If Trigger4 can prove an existing target-runtime receipt schema already carries all CgroupWitness identity/scope/coverage fields as mandatory digest-bound fields, CgroupWitness should collapse into that existing schema rather than survive as a distinct object.
A shared-parent cgroup with unrelated members falsifies exact-container attribution even if counters are readable.
A process-tree walk that cannot prove complete membership remains degraded and cannot rescue exact container telemetry.
Host-profile success does not repair container resource telemetry.
Source cleanliness/exact SHA does not repair observer scope; provenance and measurement coverage are orthogonal gates.
